en.html:
War was unfolding in heaven and on earth.

Blood washed away blood. Mountains of corpses—the expression was entirely fitting.

On the ground, archers opened gaps in the enemy lines. Masses of men advanced behind long weapons, their commanders leading on horseback. In the sky, warriors who had chosen each other as worthy opponents exchanged names, split the clouds, rode the wind and struck fiercely with their swords.

A scene of war.
Of the age called medieval.

Closer observation made a more precise division possible. The shape of the tsurugi, the warriors' methods of fighting, the infantry's weapons and clothing: none belonged to the Genpei War or the struggles of the Sengoku lords.

Above all, the banners scattered across the battlefield. Rich brocade, a golden sun on a red field.

Both armies possessed them.
Even in Yamato's history, there had been few ages, few wars, in which that could happen.

ja.html:
天と地で、争いが繰り広げられていた。
　血で血を洗う――屍山を築くという表現がまさしく
相応しい。

　地上では、射手が矢を射かけ、敵陣に間隙を穿つや、
騎馬の将帥率いる兵の群れが長物を連ねて押し進む。
　天空では、互いを好敵と見定めた武者同士が名乗り
合い、雲を裂き風に乗って、激しく太刀を打ち交わす。

　戦争の光景だ。
　中世……そう呼ばれる時代の。

　詳細に観察すれば、より正確な区分も可能だった。
　劒冑の形状、武者の戦闘形式、歩兵の武器装束――
それらはこの戦争が源平合戦でも戦国大名の抗争でも
ないことを如実に語っている。

　何よりも、戦場に散見する旗……
　赤地に金で日輪を描いた豪奢な錦織。

　それが、<ruby>どちらの陣営にも存在する<rt>・・・・・・・・・・・・</rt></ruby>。
　そんな事態、そんな戦争が起きた時代は、大和史上
にも稀であった。

A simple house in a rustic Emishi village.

The visitor was a warrior of imposing bearing. Surely a commander entrusted with a district and an army. Between him and an ordinary Emishi, the difference in station ought to have been the distance between earth and sky.

Yet the owner of the house neither rose nor gave anything resembling a proper greeting.

The warrior showed no displeasure.
...Was that the nature of their acquaintance?

en.html:
始祖村正"You are safe. That is what matters."
飽間"You were watching?"
始祖村正"Yes."
飽間"Sasaki is quite a fellow. Never gets the time or place for betrayal wrong."
飽間"The people at Yoshino ought to have been generous with a rank or two. They kept letting his demands pass, and now this."
始祖村正"No use for men moved only by profit. If he is going to betray us anyway, better have him as an enemy from the start."
飽間"...He has his own consistency. Land, rank, north to south and south to north—he keeps himself very busy, all to protect his clan."
始祖村正"That is putting the root where the branches belong. A commander ought to use his clan's strength to protect the great cause."
始祖村正"Abandon the cause to protect the clan—what sort of warrior is that?"
飽間"Yes..."
始祖村正"You would not change to the Northern Court, Akima saab, even if every last member of your clan and following were to die."
飽間"Naturally not."
始祖村正"This province of Ise lies at the Grand Shrine's feet. Nowhere do the people revere the Emperor more strongly, or hate rebels more deeply."
始祖村正"We cannot bow to a false emperor. Absolutely not."
飽間"Yes."
始祖村正"We must win..."
飽間"For that, Muramasa, your strength is needed."
始祖村正"..."
飽間"His Majesty does not say it, but I believe he is waiting impatiently. Kusunoki also."
始祖村正"Yes..."

en.html:
飽間"The master smith of Sengo village, Kuwana, in Ise—a Gorou Masamune reborn, so the rumor went. It reached His Majesty, and the imperial command to forge a tsurugi followed. Three years already."
飽間"Still not ready?"
始祖村正"Not yet."
飽間"Put Kusunoki in your tsurugi and send him out at the head of the whole Southern army: the Northern Court would vanish in a single night."
飽間"The peace Yamato's people have been waiting for would come at last..."
始祖村正"I too believe that is how it must be. Precisely why I cannot lightly begin the forging."
始祖村正"There is no doing it over..."
飽間"Still unable to devise it?"
始祖村正"More a matter of direction."
飽間"Direction?"
始祖村正"Akima saab, what do you consider the supreme tsurugi?"
飽間"Great strength, hard armor, wings swift and sharp—"
始祖村正"Do you believe it can be made?"
飽間"...No."
始祖村正"Whatever a smith's ability, he cannot forge a tsurugi that does everything. Choose one thing, give up another. It must be done."
飽間"And you cannot settle the choice?"
始祖村正"Yes."
飽間"What is best, what is supreme... is that the question?"
始祖村正"The supreme tsurugi, Akima saab, is nothing other than a tsurugi that fulfills its purpose."
始祖村正"Whom is it to help? Whom is it to destroy? ...Until that is clear, nothing begins."
飽間"The Southern Court is our ally, the Northern Court our enemy, surely?"
始祖村正"Deeper than that. More precisely. The clearer the purpose, the more I can specialize the tsurugi's abilities."

飽間 「勢州桑名、千子村の鍛冶長かじおさは、五郎正宗の 再来ならん……。 　その風評が帝のお耳に届き、劒冑鍛造の勅 が下って――早三年」
飽間 「まだ出来ぬか」
始祖村正 「まだだ」
飽間 「ぬしの劒冑を楠木殿が身に纏い、南朝全軍 を率いて押し出せば、北朝など一夜のうちに 滅び去ろう」
飽間 「大和の民の待ち望む平穏がようやく訪れる であろう……」
始祖村正 「うても、そうあらねばならぬと思うておる。 　だからこそ、軽々しく鍛造に踏み切れぬ」
始祖村正 「やり直しは利かんからの……」
飽間 「まだ工夫がつかぬか」
始祖村正 「というよりも、方向よな」
飽間 「方向？」
始祖村正 「飽間様は、至高の劒冑とは如何なるものだ と思われる？」
飽間 「力が強く、甲鉄は硬く、翼は鋭く速く――」
始祖村正 「出来るとお思いか？」
飽間 「……いや」
始祖村正 「どれほど力量ある鍛冶師でも、万能の劒冑 は打てぬ。 　何かを選び、何かを捨てねばならぬ」
飽間 「その選択が、定まらぬのか」
始祖村正 「うむ」
飽間 「何が最善、何が至高か……か？」
始祖村正 「至高の劒冑とはな、飽間様。 　役目を遂げる劒冑・・・・・・・・に他ならぬ」
始祖村正 「如何なる者の助けとなり、 　如何なる者を討ち滅ぼすのか、 　……まずそれを見定めねば、何も始まらぬ」
飽間 「味方は南朝、敵は北朝であろう？」
始祖村正 「より深く。より細かくだ。 　役目が明確であればあるほど、劒冑の性能 を特化できる」

en.html:
飽間"...I see."
始祖村正"To determine its working, first determine its purpose. That is the substance of it."
飽間"Hence the visits to battlefields."
始祖村正"Yes."
飽間"Will you arrive at a conclusion?"
始祖村正"It will take more time. I still cannot see the enemy that must be defeated."
始祖村正"A Sasaki is not enough."
飽間"I see... Very well. I shall let Kusunoki know your thinking, discreetly."
飽間"It will reach His Majesty also. Both should understand."
始祖村正"I am sorry."
飽間"Arre, between you and me, what need for such distant words?"
飽間"Devise it to your heart's content. While you do, I will keep the rebel armies out of Yoshino."
始祖村正"...I leave it to you."
